findings.title: Round-1 medium finding (path:line allowlist keying) RESOLVED
findings.evidence: git show c87ab19 Makefile: hits_in() now strips strings and comments before matching; allowlist entries are `path<TAB>stripped code<TAB>reason`; awk guards with `FILENAME == ARGV[1]` (rejects the NR==FNR empty-allowlist bug). Adversarial case 2 (5-line shift above the allowlisted entry in demos/ship_geometry_demo.gd) stayed green; case 1 (new live `1.0 - beta` in the same file) turned red; case 5 (empty allowlist) turned red with all 4 prior hits flagged.

findings.title: Regex false-positives force 3 of 4 allowlist entries
findings.evidence: The pattern `(^|[^A-Za-z0-9_.])1(\.0*)?[[:space:]]*-[[:space:]]*beta([^A-Za-z0-9_]|$)` matches the `1.-beta*beta` inside `gamma := 1./sqrt(1.-beta*beta)` — i.e. it cannot tell that the second operand is `beta*beta` (= beta^2) not `beta`. Three of the four allowlist entries (alpha_centauri_golden, planet_bounds_golden, planet_transition_golden) are excuses for this single regex limitation.
findings.suggestion: Optional follow-up: tighten the pattern to require `beta` NOT followed by `*` or any alphanumeric-or-operator (e.g. add `(?![\*\w])` after `beta`, or anchor the suffix on a stricter class). Would drop the allowlist from 4 to 1 without changing the live-hit detection on real cases. Out of scope for this round (Round-1 was about path:line keying, not the regex).

findings.title: demos/ship_geometry_demo.gd allowlist entry is a live computation
findings.evidence: Allowlist entry: `var omb: float = float(ship.get("", 1.0 - beta))`. The `1.0 - beta` IS a live computation of 1 - beta, but only as a fallback when the sim's `one_minus_beta` field is missing. The reason explicitly says "(follow-up: drop the fallback)". Display-only, not physics.
findings.suggestion: Track the follow-up (drop the fallback default, raise instead) on a sprint; not a regression risk for this round.

findings.title: Multi-line strings cause false-positive lines (known per-line sed limitation)
findings.evidence: Adversarial case 9 placed `computed as 1 - beta` inside a triple-quoted block in bridge/ai_bridge.gd; the sed `"..."` stripper only sees per-line strings, so the inner line is flagged. The live `1.0 - beta` on the line AFTER the closing quote IS correctly flagged too. The lint fails (rc=2), which is the safer outcome — false-positive over false-negative.
findings.suggestion: Document the per-line sed limitation in the recipe comment if multi-line strings containing `1 - beta` ever become common in the codebase. None exist today.
